articles.summary: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PPIH), a global leader in engineered piping and corrosion protection solutions, today announced $37 million in additional new orders during the third quarter ended October 31, 2026. Together with the approximate $28 million in new orders reported in the Company October 20, 2026 update, third quarter total new orders total approximately $65 million. Most of the additional new orders came from the MENA region, where demand for specialized pipeline solutions is supported by ongoing investments in oil and gas infrastructure and major energy-related projects, with the balance from North America. The additional bookings follow the Company's October 20, 2026 announcement of approximately $28 million in third-quarter bookings and reflect continued commercial momentum across its Middle East and North Africa (MENA) and North American (NA) regions. articles.summary: Perma-Pipe International Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: PPIH), a global leader in engineered piping and corrosion protection solutions, today announced that its subsidiary, Perma-Pipe Qatar, has agreed to acquire a 51% equity interest in Welspun Special Coating Private Limited (“WSCPL”), a newly formed company that will provide internal fusion-bonded epoxy (“IFBE”) coating and related services in India. The interest is being acquired from Welspun DI Pipes Limited (“WDI”), a wholly owned subsidiary of Welspun Corp Limited (“WCL”). WCL will also acquire the remaining 49% from WDI. The resulting joint venture adds IFBE coating to Perma-Pipe’s service offering and establishes a platform to pursue domestic and export opportunities in the Indian market.
